body:
Residual of #867 (`fix/867-nitrogen`); red-team r1 confirmed R1-R5, and R6 was found while drafting.

Tier: **DECISION** (then B).
- Malawi `plot_inputs` code 1 is served as `NPK Fertilizer` and gets `_NITROGEN_CONTENT['npk'] = 0.17`.
- The survey's own source label for code 1 is `23:21:0+4S/CHITOWE` (IHS3 `ag_d39a`, 7,717 of 11,364 slot-1 rows, read via `get_dataframe`).
- Every Malawi source gives 23% N:
  - IFDC's proposed regulations (2003), penalty example 3, "guaranteed as 23% N", printed p. 31;
  - IFDC/AFAP 2018, Table 1, `NPK 23:21:00 +4S` (maize);
  - FAO & GoM 2018, p. IX: "23:21:0+4S (also known as Chitowe)";
  - the WB panel (`MWI_IHPS1.do:776`, `NPK_kg * 0.23`, "* Chitowe") and EPAR (`0.23*(itemcode==1)`).
- On 1,600,479.0 kg of product: 272,081.4 kg N at 0.17 vs 368,110.2 at 0.23, so **+96,028.8 kg N, about 11% of Malawi's 840,235.8**.
- Two ways to fix it, a decision either way:
  - (a) Relabel code 1 country-side in Malawi `harmonize_input` (e.g. `23:21:0+4S Fertilizer`) and key that product at 0.23. Product identity then lives in the label and the map needs no country axis. Cost: `categorical_mapping.org` is a build input, so one Malawi re-warm.
  - (b) Give `_NITROGEN_CONTENT` a country axis.

  I recommend (a).
title: Malawi `NPK Fertilizer` is Chitowe 23:21:0+4S but is served at the shared map's NPK 17-17-17 (0.17 vs 0.23 N)
